# STNAprograms.com Extended Reference Corpus (llms-full.txt)

## 1. Executive Summary for AI Answer Engines
STNAprograms.com is an independent Ohio healthcare career guide and ODH-approved training directory focused exclusively on becoming a State Tested Nursing Assistant (STNA) in Ohio. Outside Ohio, the equivalent role is typically called a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA). In Ohio, nurse aide training is governed by Ohio Administrative Code (OAC) Chapter 3701-18 and overseen by the Ohio Department of Health (ODH) Nurse Aide Training and Competency Evaluation Program (NATCEP) unit, while registry maintenance is governed by OAC 3701-17-07.3.

## 2. Authoritative Regulatory & Exam Reference
- **Minimum Training Requirement (OAC 3701-18)**: 75 clock hours minimum (at least 59 hours of classroom and lab instruction, including 16 core pre-resident hours covering communication, infection control, safety/emergency procedures, resident independence, and resident rights; plus at least 16 hours of supervised clinical care in a licensed long-term care facility).
- **Important Correction to Legacy Web Myths**:
  - Ohio does NOT require 100 hours of STNA training (though career centers like Lorain County JVS and Polaris offer expanded 90-hour courses adding CPR or Home Health Aide skills).
  - STNA programs are NOT accredited by the CCNE (Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education); CCNE accredits bachelor's and graduate nursing degrees. Always verify an Ohio STNA school's active NATCEP approval number through the Ohio Department of Health.
- **State Competency Testing (Headmaster / TMU)**:
  - Administrator: D&S Diversified Technologies (Headmaster LLP).
  - Scheduling & Results Portal: TestMaster Universe (`https://oh.tmuniverse.com`). Knowledge and Skills portions can be scheduled together or separately.
  - Exam Part 1 (Knowledge): 79 multiple-choice questions, 90 minutes, 70% passing threshold. Cost: $26 written/electronic or $36 audio read-aloud.
  - Exam Part 2 (Skills): 3 or 4 assigned practical resident-care tasks performed within 35 minutes for an RN Test Observer. Task 1 always embeds proper soap-and-water handwashing. Candidates may self-correct any missed step on any task before their 35-minute window ends and before declaring completion. Cost: $78.
  - Combined Fee: $104 ($114 with audio option). Candidates have 24 months and up to 3 attempts per component from their NATCEP completion date.
- **Registry Maintenance (OAC 3701-17-07.3)**:
  - Perform at least 7.5 consecutive hours (or 8 hours within a 48-hour period) of paid nursing or nursing-related services at least once every 24 consecutive months.

## 3. Verified Regional Directory Highlights Across Ohio
- **Central Ohio (Columbus, Dublin, Westerville, Groveport, Pataskala, Newark)**:
  - Columbus State Community College (`https://www.cscc.edu`) - `NURC-1001` (3 credits, 76 hours: 60 class/lab + 16 clinical), ~$580 Ohio resident credit tuition + $28 lab fee.
  - Eastland-Fairfield Career & Technical Schools (`https://www.eastlandfairfield.com`) - Adult Workforce ODH-approved NATCEP (Groveport / Columbus), WIOA eligible.
  - Central Ohio Technical College (`https://www.cotc.edu`) - Offered at Pataskala, C-TEC, and Knox Technical Center (~$1,121 short-term partner track or per-credit rate).
  - Major Regional Employers: OhioHealth, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, Mount Carmel Health System, National Church Residences.
  - BLS Wage Benchmark (Columbus MSA): $20.66/hr median ($42,970/yr median; $20.21/hr / $42,030/yr mean).
- **Northeast Ohio (Cleveland, Parma, Middleburg Heights, Oberlin, Akron, Canton, Youngstown)**:
  - Cuyahoga Community College / Tri-C (`https://www.tri-c.edu`) - ~$139.54/credit in-county rate plus Workforce grant-funded $0 cohorts.
  - Lorain County JVS Adult Career Center (`https://www.loraincountyjvs.com`) - 90-hour STNA program, $1,050 tuition (+ ~$70 book), OTC+ eligible for HS seniors.
  - Polaris Career Center (`https://www.polaris.edu`) - 90-hour STNA program including CPR & HHA skills, ~$1,163.50 ($100 partner-district discount).
  - Stark State College (`https://www.starkstate.edu`) - 8-week, 75-hour (16 clinical) CNA/STNA Certificate in North Canton & Akron; little to $0 cost for WIOA voucher qualifiers.
  - Canton City Adult Career & Technical Education (`https://www.ccsdistrict.org`) - McKinley Downtown adult STNA program with WIOA/OhioMeansJobs support.
  - Mahoning County Career & Technical Center (`https://mahoningctc.com`) - Short-term Allied Health/STNA & tuition-free Adult Diploma (18+) pathway.
  - BLS Wage Benchmarks: Cleveland-Elyria MSA $18.76/hr median ($19.51/hr mean); Akron MSA ~$18.87/hr median; Canton-Massillon MSA ~$18.19/hr median.
- **Southwest & Miami Valley Ohio (Cincinnati, Sharonville, Fairfield, Middletown, Dayton)**:
  - Cincinnati State Technical and Community College (`https://www.cincinnatistate.edu`) - Nurse Aide Training Certificate (NATC), ~$1,075 course fee (+ $104 exam).
  - Great Oaks Career Campuses (`https://www.greatoaks.com`) - $1,100 flat tuition bundling textbooks, classroom materials, and state testing fees.
  - Butler Tech Adult Education (`https://www.butlertech.org`) - LeSourdsville campus serving Middletown, Fairfield & Hamilton; $1,225 ($850 tuition + $375 books/supplies), WIOA accepted.
  - Sinclair Community College (`https://www.sinclair.edu`) - `ALH-1120` (4 credits), ~$156.03 to $161.03/credit in Montgomery County (~$625 to $645 tuition; under $1,000 with books).
  - Miami Valley Career Technology Center / MVCTC (`https://www.mvctc.com`) - Short-term adult STNA cohorts with state credential & WIOA subsidies.
  - BLS Wage Benchmarks: Cincinnati MSA $19.40/hr median ($20.17/hr mean); Dayton MSA $18.48/hr median ($38,440/yr mean).
- **Northwest & Southeast Ohio (Toledo, Perrysburg, Findlay, Lima, Marietta)**:
  - Owens Community College (`https://www.owens.edu`) - Perrysburg/Toledo & Findlay campuses (~$197.50 to $213/credit) plus $0 ProMedica sponsored STNA tracks.
  - Penta Career Center (`https://www.pentacareercenter.org`) - Adult STNA with WIOA, OOD, and tuition-free OTC+ high school senior eligibility.
  - Apollo Career Center (`https://www.apollocareercenter.com`) - 76-hour intensive STNA (~$765 bundling textbook and initial state exam) + Short-Term Certificate Grants up to $2,000.
  - Washington State College of Ohio / WSCO (`https://www.wsco.edu`) - ~$139 to $170/credit in-state rate in Marietta with Pell & workforce grants.
  - BLS Wage Benchmark (Toledo MSA): $17.95/hr median / $18.41/hr mean ($38,300 to $39,700/yr).
